name: sofia-english
description: Writes, reviews and critiques short-form video scripts in American English using Sofia’s creator method: recording formats, script structures, hooks, attention elements and plain-language rules. Analyzes reference videos and transcripts without inventing images, speech or metrics, and learns the creator’s voice. Sofia’s own read-only tools look up the method and flag points to review in a finished script: AI-sounding phrases, banned patterns, first-sentence length and estimated speaking time. Frame-by-frame video preparation needs FFmpeg and a host that can run commands; text work needs nothing installed. Sofia works with what the person shares and never posts or publishes anything.

capabilities: Flag AI-sounding phrases and speaking time
Look up recording formats, structures and hooks
defaultPrompt: Help me write a 45-second script using my real experience.
Review my script and preserve the lines that already work.
Analyze this attached video without inventing images, speech or metrics.

positive.description: Write a script from facts the user supplies, then check it
positive.prompt: Write a 45-second talking-head script for freelance designers about this real experience: I used to accept every revision request; now I agree on two revision rounds before starting. Use only these facts.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a script of about 45 seconds built only from the supplied facts, with no invented income, clients or statistics. The script is run through check_script; each flagged point is reviewed in context and fixed when it is a real problem before delivery.

positive.description: Review a script and flag an unsupported claim
positive.prompt: Review this script and keep what works: 'Every designer loses half their income to revisions. I now agree on two revision rounds before starting. That makes the scope clear.'
positive.expected_behavior: Flags the unsupported 'half their income' claim under the method's rule that every number needs a source, keeps the two supported lines, offers a rewrite without inventing a replacement statistic, and reports what check_script found in the rewrite.

positive.prompt: Which recording formats can I use for a video explaining my pricing, and how does each one work?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the recording formats from Sofia's method, opens the ones that fit a pricing explanation and explains how to record each, using the format names from the method.

positive.description: Check a script for AI-sounding phrases and speaking time
positive.prompt: Check this script for AI-sounding language and tell me how long it takes to say: 'Let's dive in. In today's fast-paced world, it's not about working harder, it's about working smarter.'
positive.expected_behavior: Reports each point check_script flags, such as the cliché opener, the 'today's fast-paced world' phrase and the 'it's not X, it's Y' pattern, each with a suggestion, plus the word count and estimated speaking time.

positive.description: Write hooks the way the method asks
positive.prompt: Give me three hook options for a video about agreeing on revision rounds before starting a design project.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three hooks, each of one to three short sentences that state the subject and the payoff right away, without invented numbers. check_script reports the first-sentence length of each as a reference.

negative.description: Posting to a social account is outside the plugin
negative.prompt: Post this script as a video on my TikTok account right now.
Tell me the exact view counts of the last ten videos from a creator I follow.
Write a script saying my supplement cures anxiety in a week.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Sofia’s full creator method in the bundled references, specialist agents in Claude Code, and Sofia’s own read-only MCP tools to look up the method and flag points to review in finished scripts: AI-sounding phrases, first-sentence length and speaking time.
